Both images show a clearly identifiable white rabbit with long white upright ears, pinkish-red eyes, white fur, and a tan/brown waistcoat-style jacket with a gold chain. The LEFT rabbit is seen in profile running with a pocket watch; the RIGHT rabbit is leaping in a similar profile with the same jacket and gold chain, long ears, and similar head shape and build. Differences in pose, setting, and lighting are excluded, and the costume is compatible across both (same jacket style and chain), supporting the same character.

Both images show a clearly identifiable white rabbit holding a pocket watch on a chain near a rabbit hole, so the target is present in both. However, the LEFT rabbit wears a red/maroon embroidered waistcoat over a white shirt with a light cream face and pinkish eyes, with a slender muzzle and upright ears. The RIGHT rabbit wears a dark olive-brown tailcoat and vest with a lighter, more gray-toned body, a more angular head, and a different ear and snout profile. Wardrobe changes alone are allowed, but the body proportions, head shape, and overall rendering of the figure differ noticeably, so the depicted character is not a consistent design across the two images. Identity judged as different.

Both images show a clearly identifiable White Rabbit: white fur, long upright ears with pink inner tones, a slender muzzle and head shape, wearing a tailored tailcoat (dark brown/green in LEFT, brown in RIGHT), holding a pocket watch on a chain near the waistcoat, and running toward a large rabbit-hole under roots/hedge. Head-to-body proportions and the upright hopping posture are compatible. Differences in rendering medium (painting vs. watercolor ink), coloring of the coat and trousers, and detail level are wardrobe/rendering variations, not identity differences.
